addition.item: Added optional Details and Edit template locking, with regeneration from the source form on save.
Added a versioned schema migration for the template-lock columns.

change.item: Refined the form audit, editor layout, preview permissions hint, publication and debug indicators.
Editable-template generation is refused only when it is requested and no published field is editable.

fix.item: A failed locked-template regeneration now preserves the existing template without interrupting an otherwise valid form save.
Explicit editable-template generation now returns a controlled validation error when it cannot be completed.
